wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 03-005 wires the vanilla 320x200 framebuffer pipeline to a Win32 host without depending on the LauncherSession glue. The read-only refs (src/host/windowPolicy.ts and src/launcher/win32.ts) document the existing aspect-correct presentation policy and a working end-to-end launcher loop; src/host/ticAccumulator.ts is SHA-pinned by test/vanilla_parity/current-state/inventory-core-math-and-timing-modules.test.ts:314 and was treated as strict read-only. src/host/windowPolicy.ts and the src/host/win32/ subtree are NOT pinned. Wiring is implemented as a new src/vanilla/win32WindowHost.ts that imports SCREENWIDTH, SCREENHEIGHT, and computePresentationRect from windowPolicy without modifying it and exposes the pure-arithmetic building blocks a later D_DoomLoop-driven host driver can compose: framebuffer allocator, palette-to-BGRA lookup builder, indexed-to-BGRA conversion routine, BITMAPINFOHEADER builder (negative biHeight for top-down DIB), and aspect-correct presentation-rect delegation. The actual Win32 / GDI FFI calls are intentionally not inlined — they are exercised end-to-end by the existing launcher implementation and cannot be unit-tested without a real window.
publicSurface: convertIndexedFrameToBgra(source, destination, paletteLookup): void (hot-path pixel conversion)
buildVanillaBitmapInfoHeader(): Buffer (40 bytes, negative biHeight for top-down DIB)
wiringInterpretation.launcherGlueAvoidance: The new module imports only from '../host/windowPolicy.ts'. No 'from ../launcher/' imports; no LauncherSession or LauncherInputState type imports. The 'no-launcher-glue' invariant is enforced by the focused test.
